mines.mine_notes: Europe's largest open-pit copper mine. 2025: milled 39,207 kt; concentrate Cu 208 kt @ 24.55%. Proven+probable reserves 1,050 Mt @ Cu 0.24%, Au 0.16 g/t. Op profit SEK948M (→$98.3M).

Underground mines Renström, Kristineberg, Kankberg (high-grade). 2025: milled 1,768 kt; concentrate Zn 77 kt, Cu 15 kt, Pb 8 kt; metal in concentrate Zn 43 kt, Cu 3 kt, Pb 4 kt, Te 48.4 t, Au 2,509 kg, Ag 72,877 kg. Reserves: sulphide ores 11,800 kt @ Zn 4.4%, Cu 0.5%; gold ores 5,500 kt @ Au 2.8 g/t, Te 133 g/t. Op profit SEK2,473M (→$256.6M).

mines.mine_notes: World's most productive underground zinc mine. 2025: milled 3,585 kt; concentrate Zn 188 kt, Cu 7 kt, Pb 48 kt; metal in concentrate Zn 102 kt, Cu 0.7 kt, Pb 39 kt, Au 747 kg, Ag 256 t. Reserves 104,300 kt @ Zn 2.5%, Ag 88 g/t. Op profit SEK4,411M (→$457.8M). Expansion to 4.5 Mt/y ongoing (SEK1.6B, 2025-2030).

mines.mine_notes: Large Finnish open-pit Ni-Cu-PGE mine (acquired 2016). 2025: milled 10,155 kt; concentrate Cu 93 kt @24.4%, Ni 137 kt @8.5%; metal in concentrate Cu 23 kt, Ni 12 kt. Reserves 88,400 kt @ Cu 0.31%, Ni 0.22%. Op profit SEK984M (→$102.1M).

Large underground zinc mine, Navan (restarted 2024 after 2023 care & maintenance). 2025: milled 1,441 kt; concentrate Zn 143 kt @52.9%, Pb 16 kt @45.5%; metal in concentrate Zn 76 kt, Pb 7 kt, Ag 642 kg (21 koz). Reserves 16,600 kt @ Zn 5.4%, Pb 1.3%. Op profit SEK58M (→$6.0M).

100% acquired April 2025 from Lundin (SEK14,391M incl. Zinkgruvan). Two concentrators (copper + zinc). 2025 (post-acquisition period): milled copper ore 1,670 kt, zinc ore 1,446 kt; concentrate Zn 171 kt @45.4%, Cu 101 kt @22.8%, Pb 23 kt @27.9%; metal in concentrate Zn 78 kt, Cu 23 kt, Pb 6 kt, Ag 42 t (1,345 koz). Reserves: zinc ore 13,800 kt @ Zn 7.8%; copper ore 1,600 kt @ Cu 2.0%, Pb 3.3%. Op profit SEK473M (→$49.1M).

mines.mine_notes: Underground zinc mine, continuous operation since 1857. 100% acquired April 2025. 2025 (post-acquisition): milled zinc ore 884 kt, copper ore 194 kt; concentrate Zn 102 kt @51.4%, Cu 13 kt @27.3%, Pb 29 kt @70.8%; metal in concentrate Zn 52 kt, Cu 3 kt, Pb 21 kt, Ag 54 t (1,728 koz). Reserves: zinc ore 24,100 kt @ Zn 7.1%, Pb 1.7%; copper ore 24,000 kt @ Cu 1.9%. Op profit SEK358M (→$37.1M).

notes: Business Area Mines (all 100% owned): 2025 metal in concentrate: Zn 351 kt, Cu 104 kt, Ni 12 kt, Pb 77 kt, Au 5,140 kg (165,247 oz), Ag 443,973 kg (14,274 koz), Te 48,398 kg.
